出生地: 美国,华盛顿哥伦比亚特区
简介: Versatile veteran character actor Jonathan Banks was born in Washington D.C in 1947. While growing up he always had an interest in acting and stage work, so decided to pursue a career in entertainment. To this day he is a very accomplished stage actor. While acting in film, he usually plays sinister types or villains. Most recently he can be seen in Breaking Bad (2008) as Mike Ehrmantraut.
